subject: plotting a function typed in by user - a first demo

messages.subject: plotting a function typed in by user - a first demo
parts:
I have made a demo of an app where the user enters a function in  a textInput and a plot is produced. Several properties of the function, such as the ranges and parameter values, may be customized. The plots can also be tweaked to some extent. 

https://gist.github.com/ptoche/8376799

This demo app is a by-product of something I was doing for my research, so it's not a full-time endeavour and thus not completely finished and fully tested.

There are many things that I'd like to improve. For instance, right now the user must type in :

function(a=1,b=2,...){a*b} 

where only the letters a, b, c, d can be used as functional arguments. I'd like to generalize this to all single letters of the alphabet as well as things like x1, y2, maybe even alpha, beta. 

As a priority, I'd like to simplify the input stage, where the user could simply enter:

a*b 

in the box, rather than typing out function(etc..

I've only looked at Firefox and Chrome, it's possible that the panels look weird in other browsers. The layout is kind of experimental.

Feedback and suggestions welcome.

You can run the app like this:
library("shiny")
runGist("https://gist.github.com/ptoche/8376799")
